name: Afraid
description: Cower in fear, hold stance.

name: Akimbo
description: Stands with fists on hips looking forward, hold stance.

name: Alakazam
description: Thrusts out one arm like you are performing a magic trick.

name: AlakazamReact
description: Flash of light and smoke and a random object is left where your character was. After a few seconds, the character reappears, looks around and shrugs. Before issue 15, object was always a pumpkin.

name: Angry
description: Fists on hips and slouches forward, as if glaring or grumbling, hold stance.

name: ArachnosMug
description: Drinks out of an Arachnos-branded coffee mug.

name: AssumePositionWall
description: Turns around and spreads legs as if getting frisked, hold stance.

name: AtEase
description: Stands in the 'at ease' military position (legs spread out slightly, hands behind back) stance, hold stance.

name: Attack
description: Gives a charge! type point, fists on hips stance.

name: BatLookout
description: Hold a bat and look around. Repeat to cycle through two variations, one standing still, one pivoting around in place.

name: BatSmash
description: Hit someone or something with a bat, repeat.

name: BatSmashReact
description: React as if getting hit with a bat, often used in duo with BatSmash

name: BigWave
description: Waves over the head, fists on hips stance.

name: Binoculars
description: Gaze through a large pair of binoculars, hold stance.

name: BlankFiller
description: No effect. Neither starts nor stops an emote.

name: BoomBox
description: Summons forth a boombox (it just appears) and leans over to turn it on, stands up and does a sort of dance. (boombox plays music, several different short songs -- Track Listing)

name: Bow
description: Chinese/Japanese style bow with palms together, returns to normal stance.

name: BowDown
description: Thrusts hands forward, then points down, as if ordering someone else to bow before you.

name: Burp
description: A raunchy belch, wipes mouth with arm afterward, ape-like stance.

name: BuzzOff
description: Makes a go away gesture.

name: Camera
description: Hold an old-fashioned camera, and periodically take a picture, repeats.

name: Cameraphone
description: The smartphone as a camera. Not a selfie, forward facing.

name: CellPhone
description: Talk on a early 2000s cellphone, LCD screen and physical numeric keypad, periodically nodding, shaking head, and gesturing with hand, repeats. See also Smartphone.

name: Cheer
description: Randomly does one of 3 cheers, 1 fist raised, 2 fists raised or 2 fists lowered, repeats.

name: Chicken
description: Character flaps his arms and impersonates a chicken, ends in the Akimbo stance.

name: Clap
description: Claps hands several times, crossed arms stance.

name: Clipboard
description: Write notes on a clipboard, repeats.

name: Coin
description: Flips a coin, randomly displays heads or tails, and hold stance. Coin image remains until stance broken.

name: Collapse
description: appear dizzy, then fall backwards, fainting.

name: CrossArms
description: Crosses arms, stance (sliiiiiightly different than most other crossed arm stances).

name: Crouch
description: Squats down into a cat-like ready-to-pounce position, holds stance.

name: Dance
description: Randomly performs a dance.

name: Dance1
description: Dances with elbows by hips.

name: Dance2
description: Dances with fists raised.

name: Dance3
description: Swaying hands by hips, aka 'Really Bad' dancing.

name: Dance4
description: Swaying hands up in the air, like in a breeze.

name: Dance5
description: As Dance4, but jumping as well.

name: Dance6
description: The monkey.

name: DDCoffee
description: Character drinks coffee out of a Drenched Donuts cup with a lid, looped.

name: DDCoffee2
description: Character drinks coffee out of a Drenched Donuts cup without a lid, looped.

name: Despair
description: Falls to knees, head tilted forward, hands resting limply on thighs.

name: Dice
description: Picks up, shakes and rolls a die, randomly displays the results (1-6), default stance. Die image quickly fades, so make a quick note of what the roll was!

name: Dig
description: Digs into the ground using a rusty shovel. Throws dirt behind.

name: Disagree
description: Shakes head, crosses hand in front, then offers an alternative, crossed arms stance.

name: Doublefacepalm
description: Slaps both hands on face, shakes head in disbelief.

name: Donut1
description: Character eats a strawberry donut, looped.

name: Donut2
description: Character eats a chocolate donut, looped.

name: Donut3
description: Character eats a donut with rainbow sprinkles, looped.

name: Donut4
description: Character eats a plain donut, looped.

name: Donut5
description: Character eats a white donut with blue sprinkles, looped.

name: Drat
description: Raises fists up, then down, stomping at the same time, same ending stance as Frustrated.

name: Drink
description: Character holds a cup and drinks from it.

name: Drum
description: Beats a large wooden drum.

name: DrumDance
description: The Tuatha Drum dance.

name: DrumLow
description: Kneels and plays a small wooden drum on the ground.

name: DustOff
description: Character dusts off his hands.

name: EatDonut
description: Character eats a donut; note that this and EatFood have potential to look odd when performed on some model shapes such as the Dwarf Star form of Kheldians.

name: EatFood
description: Character eats a bit of random food, usually a hot dog, hamburger or sandwich; Dwarf form of Kheldians and other "monster" skeletons will instead gnaw on a large bone.

name: Explain
description: Hold arms out in a "wait a minute" gesture, motion alternatives, then shrug.

name: EvilLaugh
description: Extremely melodramatic, overacted evil laugh.

name: FancyBow
description: A much more elegant, ball-room style bow, falls into neutral forward facing stance.

name: Fishing
description: Hold out a fishing rod and reel, hold stance.

name: Flashlight
description: Look around with a flashlight out in one of two stances, either the FlashlightUp stance or the FlashlightDown stance. Note that the light is only on at night.

name: FlashlightDown
description: Look around with a flashlight aimed below head level. Note that the light is only on at night.

name: FlashlightUp
description: Look around with a flashlight aimed above head level. Note that the light is only on at night.

name: Flex1
description: Fists raised, flexing arms stance, hold stance. (This is called a "double biceps" pose.)

name: Flex2
description: A side-stance flexing arms, hold stance. (This is a sideways variation on the "most muscular" pose.)

name: Flex3
description: Another side-stance, flexing arms, hold stance. (This is an open variation on the "side chest" pose.)

name: Flip
description: Character performs a backflip.

name: FlippingCoin
description: Flip a coin into the air and catch it without checking whether it is heads or tails, repeats.

name: FloatBooks
description: Places three magical tomes floating in mid-air, and character glances among them and holds stance.

name: Flypose1
description: During flight, changes flight pose to arms fully outstretched in front.

name: Flypose2
description: During flight, changes flight pose to one arm in front, one arm pulled back to side, and one knee pulled upward; Superman pose

name: Flypose3
description: During flight, changes flight pose to arms stretched forward and to the side in a Y-formation.

name: Flypose4
description: During flight, changes flight pose to head up and arms pulled back to side, in an "I dare you to shoot at me" pose.

name: Frustrated
description: Raises both fists and leans backwards, shaking fists and head, leads into a quick-breathing angry-looking stance.

name: GetSome
description: Turns to the side and pats butt in defiance.

name: GhoulFlex
description: Performs the Praetorian Ghouls' standing animation.

name: Grief
description: Falls to knees, hands on forehead, looks up and gestures a sort of "why me?" look with hands, goes into a sort of depressed slump while on knees, holds stance.

name: Hamburger
description: Character takes out and eats a hamburger; Dwarf form of Kheldians and other "monster" skeletons will instead gnaw on a large bone.

name: Hand
description: Hold hand out in a "talk to the hand" gesture.

name: HandsUp
description: Two stances with hands up, one standing and one kneeling.

name: Hi
description: Simple greeting wave, fists on hips stance.

name: Hmmm
description: Stare into the sky, rubbing chin, thinking.

name: HoldTorch
description: Produce burning torch and hold it up.

name: Hotdog
description: Character takes out and eats a Hot Dog; Dwarf form of Kheldians and other "monster" skeletons will instead gnaw on a large bone.

name: Howl
description: Lean back and howl at the moon.

name: Huh
description: Raises hands and cocks head in a classical "What?"/"I don't know" look, neutral forward facing stance.

name: Idle1
description: Stands still, body slightly angled and hands at sides, breathing, hold stance.

name: Idle2
description: Stands still, facing forward and hands at sides, breathing.

name: InnerTube
description: Character floats in a random inner tube and sips from a drink, looped. Only works while swimming.

name: InnerTube1
description: Character floats in a strawberry donut inner tube and sips from a drink, looped. Only works while swimming.

name: InnerTube2
description: Character floats in a chocolate donut inner tube and sips from a drink, looped. Only works while swimming.

name: InnerTube3
description: Character floats in a neon green inner tube and sips from a drink, looped. Only works while swimming.

name: InnerTube4
description: Character floats in a cow print inner tube and sips from a drink, looped. Only works while swimming.

name: InnerTube5
description: Character floats in a naval academy inner tube and sips from a drink, looped. Only works while swimming.

name: InnerTube6
description: Character floats in a lifeguard-style inner tube and sips from a drink, looped. Only works while swimming.

name: Invent
description: Character fiddles with some kind of glowing Rubik's Cube-style device that hovers on its own, repeats.

name: Jackhammer
description: Uses a jackhammer.

name: JellyDonut
description: Character eats a jelly donut with strawberry filling, looped.

name: JellyDonut2
description: Character eats a jelly donut with lemon filling, looped.

name: JumboDog
description: Pulls out and eats a large hot dog with mustard or ketchup.

name: JumpingJacks
description: Does jumping jacks, repeats.

name: Kneel
description: Quickly kneels on both knees with hands on thighs (looks insanely uncomfortable), holds stance.

name: Kneel2
description: Takes a knee, identical to Rest.

name: Kneel3
description: Takes a knee, similar to Rest, but head bowed, looking to the ground.

name: Kneel4
description: Takes a knee, similar to Rest, but body and head upright, hands resting on one knee.

name: Kneel5
description: Kneels on both knees, head bowed, hands on the ground.

name: Knuckles
description: Cracks knuckles.

name: Laptop
description: Summon a laptop and a stand for it, and start typing.

name: Laugh
description: Fists on hips, tosses head back and laughs.

name: Laugh2
description: Another style of laugh.

name: Lecture
description: Waves/shakes hands in different motions in a lengthy lecture, fists on hips stance.

name: Ledgesit
description: Random Ledgesit

name: Ledgesit1
description: Hands on ledge

name: Ledgesit2
description: One leg up casual

name: Ledgesit3
description: Forearms on knees

name: Ledgesit4
description: Leaning back

name: Liedown
description: Lays down on the right side, in a semi-curled position.

name: ListenPoliceBand
description: Character produces the police band scanner and opens its display. Heroes only. Villains can use ListenStolenPoliceBand, but it requires unlocking.

name: ListenStolenPoliceBand
description: Listens in on the heroes' PPD police band radio. Unlocked by earning the Outlaw Badge (Villains only). Heroes can use ListenPoliceBand, without any unlock requirement.

name: Lookup
description: Steps back slightly, hands held slightly out with palms down at waist level, looks up in wonder.

name: MartialArts
description: Warm up/practice punches and blocks.

name: MilitarySalute
description: Stands in the military-style heads-high hand on forehead salute stance.

name: Newspaper
description: Materializes a newspaper (don't ask) and reads it.

name: No
description: Shakes head and waves hands in front of character, crossed arms stance.

name: Nod
description: Fists on hips, nod yes, hold stance.

name: None
description: Cancels the current emote, if any, and resumes default standing animation cycle.

name: Noooo
description: (that's 4 o's in noooo...) Shaking fist.

name: ObserveDice
description: Character looks downward, hands on knees, periodically rubbing palms together.

name: Onigiri
description: Character eats a rice ball.

name: Pamphlet
description: Holds out pamphlets. The pamphlets say "EXTRA / ~Paragon Times~ / Heroes Halt Havoc!"

name: Panhandle
description: Sits and waves a tin cup around as if asking for change.

name: Paper
description: Plays rock/paper/scissors, picking paper (displays all three symbols for about 6 seconds, then displays and holds your choice until stance is broken).

name: ParagonMug
description: Drinks out of a Paragon City-branded coffee mug.

name: Peerin
description: Make "hand binoculars" and look around, repeats.

name: PickLock
description: "Picks" a lock using a large hammer.

name: Plot
description: Rubs hands together while hunched over.

name: PocketDog
description: Pulls out and eats a hot dog with ketchup or mustard, discarding a disposable hot dog plate in the process. Despite the name, the pocket dog is slightly larger than the dog in e hotdog.

name: Point
description: Extends left arm and points in direction character is facing, hold stance.

name: Praise
description: Kneel prostrate and and repeatedly bow in adoration.

name: Protest
description: Hold hold up one of several randomly selected mostly unreadable protest signs (see notes below).

name: PumpkinMug
description: Drinks out of a pumpkin-shaped coffee mug filled with sugary treats.

name: ReadBook
description: Open a book in one hand, read while pointing at words with the other. (animation added for Issue 12)

name: Research
description: Pull out book and begin consulting it while making gestures in the air with other.

name: ResearchLow
description: Same as Research, but kneeling on one knee.

name: Roar
description: Claws air, roaring, ape-like stance.

name: Rock
description: Plays rock/paper/scissors, picking rock (displays all three symbols for about 6 seconds, then displays and holds your choice until stance is broken).

name: Salute
description: A hand-on-forehead salute, fists on hips stance.

name: Sandwich
description: Character takes out and eats a half sandwich; Dwarf form of Kheldians and other "monster" skeletons will instead gnaw on a large bone.

name: Scissors
description: Plays rock/paper/scissors, picking scissors (displays all three symbols for about 6 seconds, then displays and holds your choice until stance is broken).

name: Score1
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 1, holds stance.

name: Score2
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 2, holds stance.

name: Score3
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 3, holds stance.

name: Score4
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 4, holds stance.

name: Score5
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 5, holds stance.

name: Score6
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 6, holds stance.

name: Score7
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 7, holds stance.

name: Score8
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 8, holds stance.

name: Score9
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 9, holds stance.

name: Score10
description: Holds a black on white scorecard up, displaying a 10, holds stance.

name: Screen
description: Character observes and writes like on a monitor or chalkboard.

name: Shocked
description: Steps back slightly, trembling hands held out with palms toward face, looks down at palms.

name: Shucks
description: Swings fist and head dejectedly, neutral forward facing stance (not the default stance, same as huh/shrug).

name: Sit
description: Sits down, legs forward, with knees bent, elbows on knees, and slightly slumped over, stance.

name: SitBench1
description: Sits leaning back with legs at almost straight angle.

name: SitBench2
description: Sits with right leg crossed under left.

name: SitBench3
description: Sprawls out with arms spread out, presumably on the back of the sofa or bench.

name: SitBench4
description: Sits upright with legs slightly extended in front.

name: SitChair1
description: Sits with hands on knees, legs slightly spread and squared.

name: SitChair2
description: Sits with arms on legs, slightly hunched forward.

name: SitChair3
description: Sits with arms on legs, ladylike.

name: SitExecutiveChair
description: Sit with arms at side, as if on armrests, and leaning back.

name: SitStool
description: Sit with one leg propped slightly higher than the other.

name: SitTable1
description: Chin resting on back of hand.

name: SitTable2
description: Sit with chin in hand.

name: Slap
description: Slap someone or something.

name: SlapReact
description: React to getting slapped, often used in duo with Slap (difficult to time just right to appear to actually get slapped).

name: Slash
description: Slashing motion across throat.

name: Sleep
description: Body goes limp while still standing. Zzz's appear above character's head.

name: Slrcamera
description: Pulls out modern SLR camera and takes picture.

name: Smack
description: Backhand slap.

name: Smartphone
description: Pulls out post-2010 smartphone, touchscreen with virtual keyboard, periodically nodding, shaking head, and gesturing with hand, repeats. See also CellPhone.

name: Spraypaint
description: Looks around, crouches, and begins spraying a can of paint. Periodically shakes can. No graffiti 'tag' will appear, however.

name: SpookyDonut
description: Character eats a donut with orange sprinkles, looped.

name: Stop
description: Raises your right hand above your head, hold stance.

name: Swoon
description: Swoon, hand up to face, faint, falling forward with a thunk.

name: Talk
description: Stand upright and slight bob head as if in a long diatribe. Periodically make hand gestures, repeats.

name: Tantrum
description: Performs the Praetorian Ghouls' death throes animation.

name: Tarzan
description: Beats chest and howls, angry-looking stance.

name: Taunt1
description: Taunts, beckoning with one hand, then slaps fist into palm, repeating stance.

name: Taunt2
description: Taunts, beckoning with both hands, combat stance.

name: Teabag
description: Character produces a cup of tea and bobs a teabag in it endlessly. Loops.

name: Text
description: Pulls out smartphone, starts thumb typing.

name: Thanks
description: Gestures with hand, neutral forward facing stance.

name: Thewave
description: Does the wave (as seen in stadiums at sporting events), neutral facing forward stance.

name: ThreatHand
description: Raise hand, as if threatening to backhand someone.

name: Type
description: Types as if on a keyboard.

name: Typegauntlet
description: Types on forearm as if on a number pad.

name: Vendor
description: Character loops between calling out to the crowd, pointing to an object in front of the character (both hands), and pointing to an object to the left/behind (left hand). When flying, the character will not loop animations.

name: Victory
description: Raises hands excitedly, and then again less excitedly, and then a third time almost non-chalantly, falls into neutral forward facing stance.

name: Waiting
description: Cross arms on chest and tap foot. Periodically check wristwatch, and slice hand through air in an "I can't believe he's still not here!" motion. Repeats.

name: WalkieTalkie
description: Holds large walkie talkie (handheld radio) in front of face as if talking, scans around.

name: WallLean
description: Casually lean against a wall in one of two postures (looks very odd when not standing next to wall).

name: WarmHands
description: Warms hands as if over a fire. Shivering and breathing on hands included in the animation loop.

name: Watermelon
description: Character takes out and eats from a slice of watermelon (seeds and all); Dwarf form of Kheldians and other "monster" skeletons will instead gnaw on a large bone.

name: WaveFist
description: Waves fist, hoots and then claps (its a cheer), crossed arms stance.

name: Welcome
description: Open arms welcoming, fists on hips stance.

name: Whistle
description: Whistles (sounds like a police whistle), ready-stance.

name: Winner
description: Fist in fist cheer, right, and then left, neutral forward facing stance.

name: WinterDonut
description: Character eats a donut with red, blue and white sprinkles, looped.

name: WinterMug
description: Drinks out of a winter-themed coffee mug filled with sugary treats.

name: Wounded
description: Stand in one spot and wobble, as if extremely drunk or stunned.

name: YataYata
description: Make "blah blah blah" gesture with hand and look bored, as if to say, "Is he still talking?"

name: YoureWelcome
description: Bows head and gestures with hand, neutral forward facing stance.

name: Yes
description: Big (literally) thumbs up and an affirmative nod, fists on hips stance.

name: Yoga
description: Sits down cross legged with hands on knees/legs, holds stance.

name: Dice7
description: Picks up, shakes and rolls a die, displays a 7, default stance. Unlocked by earning the Burkholder's Bane Badge (from the hero-side Ernesto Hess Task Force) or Deuces Wild Badge (a St. Martial exploration badge).

name: MATablet
description: Consults a clipboard-sized data pad. Unlocked by earning the Thrill Seeker Badge.

name: votmmug
description: Drinks from a coffee mug emblazoned with the text "Villain of the Month" and an image of Jack in Irons. Unlocked by earning the Villain of the Month Badge.

name: PowerDown
description: Mechanically slumps into a power-down state.

name: PowerUp
description: Mechanically straightens up into a powered-up state.

name: RobotDance
description: Does the robot dance.

name: CardTrick
description: Performs a fancy trick with playing cards.

name: Juggle
description: Juggles three brightly-colored balls.

name: JuggleElectricity
description: Juggles three electric sparks.

name: JuggleFire
description: Juggles three fireballs.

name: JuggleMagic
description: Juggles three brightly-colored magical spheres.

name: Calculate
description: Traces through floating mathematical equations in the air.

name: Experiment
description: Mixes chemicals together, which explode in one of two ways, repeats indefinitely.

name: BringIt
description: Arms cartwheel in a Matrix-Style warm up pose, right hand extended forward, fingers motion twice in a "come get some" taunt. Holds pose indefinitely If the character is holding props from another emote, the props will not disappear.

name: PushUp
description: Character drops to a military style push-up routine, clapping hands at apex several times, then switching to one handed push-ups, repeats indefinitely.

name: Growl
description: Crouch on all fours like a beast, swiping arm and making menacing head movements, repeats indefinitely.

name: ShowOff
description: Puts arms out to sides, small hand movements and looking around as if to say "I'm awesome, look how awesome I am".

name: Propose
description: Propose, as for marriage.

name: ThrowConfetti
description: Throws confetti into the air.

name: ThrowRice
description: Throws rice into the air.

name: ThrowRosePetals
description: Throws rose petals into the air.

name: DrinkEnriche
description: standing with and drinking from a plastic bottle of Enriche

name: ProtestResistance
description: protest against the resistance and each execution of the emote will randomly call one of the generic protest signs or one of several signs that 'cross out' the symbol of the resistance (the chevron)

name: ProtestLoyalist
description: protest against the loyalists and each execution of the emote will randomly call one of the generic protest signs or one of several signs that 'cross out' the symbol of the loyalists (the gold star)

name: PraetorianSalute
description: The Praetorian salute

name: StanceHero1
description: A heroic stance, head slightly lifted

name: StanceHero2
description: A heroic stance, turned slightly to the side

name: StanceVillain1
description: An intimidating wide stance

name: StanceVillain2
description: A judgmental stance, arms crossed

name: AirGuitar
description: Air Guitar

name: Basketball
description: Basketball Dribble

name: DiscoDance
description: Disco Dance Sweet spot to sync is when the right hand has passed over the forehead and is coming down past the eyebrow.

name: KarateDance
description: Karate Dance, as if dancing to (Everyone Was) Kung Fu Fighting

name: OpenGift
description: Open Gift, the same animation as Winter Event presents

name: Pool
description: Talk Pool

name: PopDance
description: Pop Dance similar to Michael Jackson's Billie Jean stage tour. Sound is just footsteps and fabric rustling. Sweet spot to sync is when the right arm is thrust out and the left hand is behind the head.

name: Soccer
description: Soccer Kick

name: Hiss
description: crouch, double handed kitty-claw swipes, return to idle, hissing sound

name: Savage
description: monkey movements including: crouched jumping, scratching head and side, final pose is crouch with arms hanging limp in front; monkey grunt noises

name: Sniff
description: crouch down with head up sniffing the air with sniffing noise

name: HeroLoyal
description: You stand akimbo on your alignment icon with seven blue stars circling you like a sash. You nod back and forth as to a crowd occasionally throwing them a pageant wave.

name: VigilanteLoyal
description: You stand akimbo on your alignment icon with seven bluish purple stars circling you like a sash. You nod back and forth as to a crowd occasionally throwing them a pageant wave.

name: VillainLoyal
description: You stand akimbo on your alignment icon with seven red stars circling you like a sash. You nod back and forth as to a crowd occasionally throwing them a pageant wave.

name: RogueLoyal
description: You stand akimbo on your alignment icon with seven yellow stars circling you like a sash. You nod back and forth as to a crowd occasionally throwing them a pageant wave.

name: Inspiration
description: You put your hand to your chin as if in thought. Then you raise your arm in the air as a light bulb hums to life over your head.

name: HotTemper
description: You stomp your feet twice, waving your arms, then steam comes out your ears.

name: TrainWhistle
description: An old-fashioned train whistle materializes and you pull the cord twice to make it blow.

name: Snowflakes
description: You throw snowflakes up into the air.

name: OfferGift
description: You reach behind your back, take out a gift box, and hold it out with one hand.

name: ReceiveGift
description: You raise both hands in surprise, then lay both hands out. A gift box appears in your outstretched palms, then you put it behind your back, where it disappears.

name: CatchBreath
description: You bend over and put your hands on your knees as if winded.

name: UltimatePower
description: You crouch briefly and raise your hands to the sky with a bolt of lightning and clap of thunder.

name: Facepalm
description: You slap your hand on your face and shake your head in disbelief.

name: FireworkBloom
description: You launch a single firework blast, with report, into the air.

name: FireworkRocket
description: You launch four streaming fireworks into the air.

name: FireworkSparkle
description: You launch a single firework blast, with crackles, into the air.

name: CCBackflip
description: Performs a backflip, with a flash of light at the apex.

name: CCSalute
description: Gives an informal salute, followed by a flash of light.

name: CCHowl
description: Howl up at the sky, followed by a flash of light.

name: CCEvilLaugh
description: Flames spread from hands while laughing evilly, then suddenly envelop body.

name: CCPeacebringer
description: Uses the same animation as when a Peacebringer changes forms. Unlocked by being the Peacebringer Archetype.

name: CCWarshade
description: Uses the same animation as when a Warshade changes forms. Unlocked by being the Warshade Archetype.

name: CCVanguardSigil
description: Casts a sigil underfoot, raises arms and flash of light. Unlocked by purchasing for 100 Vanguard Merits at a Vanguard Crafting Table OR by unlocking the Vanguard Pack.

name: CCMurderOfCrows
description: Raises arms, a murder of crows flies to the caster, then away. Unlocked by selecting it as the reward for doing Dr. Kane's House of Horror.

name: CCCast
description: Thrusts out one arm as in casting a magic spell, followed by a flash of light.

name: CCSpin
description: Winds up and spins around, creating a small tornado, followed by a flash of light.

name: CCLightning
description: Reaches one arm up, and is struck by lightning from above.

name: CCPrestoChango
description: Reaches both arms up, and is surrounded by a cloud of smoke which fades.

name: CCDrinkFormula
description: Chug an Erlenmeyer flask of green liquid, smash it on the ground, writhe as if in pain, followed by a sudden burst of yellow smoke.

name: CCSuperSerum
description: Jab GIANT hypodermic needle into right arm, glow brightly while beating chest, glow fades.

name: CCSmokeBomb
description: Throw a smoke bomb to the floor, obscuring the character, smash it on the ground then the smoke slowly clears. When Flying - Smokebomb is thrown, costume changes, then smoke appears and vanishes. Possibly a bug as the smoke is delayed.

name: CCNinjaLeap
description: Crouch and then spring swiftly into the air (with a whoosh sound) vanishing then reappear, landing from above in a crouch, then standing. When Flying - Character leaps, spinning corkscrew style upwards, when landing, the "crane" pose is taken on by the flying character instead of the crouch-then-stand. Crane Pose is maintained.

name: CCDimensionShift
description: Make the Teleport arm movement, several transparent 'ghost' copies of the character's body expand out to either side; the copies fold back into the character, and in a flash of light, costume changes.

name: CCEnergyMorph
description: Crouch on all fours on floor; blue energy bubble appears around character; explodes out, leaving character in different costume and a crater effect on the floor. Flying: Hang limp in the air

name: CCRapidBoil
description: Lean forward as in pain, green bubbles ooze to the surface, then explode in a huge green spray, leaving character in different costume.

name: CCFeatherBurst
description: Scrunch down and shake, flash of light, and burst of feathers.

name: CCFeatherSpin
description: Whirlwind spin, flash of light, and burst of feathers.

name: CCFurBurst
description: Scrunch down and shake, grey cloud, and burst of fur.

name: CCFurSpin
description: Whirlwind spin, grey cloud, and burst of fur.

name: CCPressureRelease
description: You stomp on the ground and are engulfed in the resulting cloud of steam..

name: CCOilStrike
description: You summon an eruption of black liquid from below and are quickly covered completely by it.

name: CCGiftBurst
description: You look up and a gift box lands on you, then you burst out in a shower of confetti.

name: CCFireworks
description: You raise your arms as fireworks erupt from your feet in a flash of light and sound.

name: CCIceBlock
description: You crouch down, encasing yourself in a block of ice, then burst free.

name: CCNuke
description: You crouch down, then explode up in a nuclear mushroom cloud.

name: CCPureEnergy
description: You crouch in, as if the center of an atom molecule, and explode in a burst of energy.

name: CCStoneBlock
description: You crouch down, encasing yourself in a block of stone, then burst free.

name: CCConfettiThrow
description: You reach into your pocket and throw confetti into the air in a burst of light.

name: CCInnerWill
description: You channel energy from deep within yourself and release it in a burst of light.

name: CCLightMagic
description: A swirling cirlce of runes appears at your feet, engulfs you in bright light, and you emerge in a burst of light.

name: CCRainbow
description: You are brightly illuminated by the end of a rainbow and you emerge in a burst of light.
